The '''Gravdinia system''' was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the beverage known as [[Gravdinian Ale]].<ref name="Journal5">{{JournalCite|5|One of a Kind (short story)}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Gravdinian Ale]]|system=Gravdinia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Gravdinia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-10.<ref name="TEA" />
